note: @noble/ciphers is installed at exact 1.3.0 (decision 353, section 11). No other ciphers version is allowed. @noble/hashes 1.8.0 is the existing section 11 pin, used here for HKDF-SHA256. @frank/nakamoto is the only ECDH implementation. The cipher package's block-chaining mode is not called. Suite 65535 is not produced.
